entries.claim: The source prescribes three progressively higher celebrant intonations, each repeated by all in the same tone; five selected utterances derive from this ritual prescription, not five additional printed witness words.

The approved Benziger page prints Alleluia, Confitemini Domino and the two Laudate Dominum verses. The preceding rubric requires the celebrant to intone Alleluia three times, each repeated by all; the single written word is not a claim that it is sung only once.
